capabilities.justification: Reads one .warrant specification and, for the v1 gate, one corpus.json; for verify-v2 also one corpus.profile, an optional evidence.bindings and, inside the fixture directory named on the command line, corpus.json, cases.tfv, optional corpus.profile and exactly the chunks/<claim>.txt files it derives. Every path is supplied on the command line or derived from a validated claim name, size-capped before parsing and must be a regular file (symbolic links are refused).

Writes the oracle's own enumeration digests, or (dump-lowering) the canonical lowering dump of one document, to the single file named by --out or --emit-v2; it never writes beside the corpus and never overwrites an input.
Prints the gate verdict, the level census and, for a failed verify-v2, the group, path and message of each mismatch (never input bytes).

justification: Offline oracle: it parses and evaluates hostile .warrant text with no eval, exec or subprocess, opens no network connection and reads no environment variable.
